audio.music_mood: Tense underwater ambient music with ticking clock and buzzer SFX

content.concept_description: A player attempts to clear an arrow pipe labyrinth to release trapped blue creatures before a 35-second timer runs out, ultimately failing.
content.why_it_works: The rapid countdown timer and complex maze layout create intense time pressure and ego threat, enticing viewers to try solving it themselves.

visuals.primary_color: Steel Blue (#4682B4), Underwater Teal (#1C4E68), Crimson Red (#C8102E)
visuals.notable_characters: Clownfish, blue tang, little blue diamond creatures
visuals.notable_objects: Arrow maze pipes, pressure gauge timer, FAIL stamp, search bar

emotions.emotional_arc: Curious engagement quickly builds into rising tension and urgency as the clock runs down, ending in frustration upon failure.

end_card.cta_and_text: 00:39 - Search bar types 'Amaze GO!', Google Play and App Store badges

gameplay.core_gameplay_notes: Tapping directional arrows in a tangled pipe labyrinth to clear paths and allow trapped items to fall through to the exit before time runs out.

chapterization.chapter_description: Arrow maze container with trapped blue creatures and a 35-second countdown timer.
Player taps out arrows, releasing batches of blue creatures into the pipes.
Timer drops below 15 seconds with red flashing emergency lights as moves get frantic.
Timer hits 00, screen desaturates, and a large FAIL stamp appears.
End card displaying the app icon, animated search bar typing 'Amaze GO!', and app store badges.
